name: AI Futures Model
blurb: Lifland/Halstead/Kastner/Kokotajlo (Dec 2025) milestone + takeoff harness, instanced as a BWM forecast.
mechanism:
The AI Futures Model dates three capability milestones — SAR, SIAR, and ASI — under five named author scenarios plus an aggregate (`atc`). Each (scenario, milestone) pair is its own forecast question; the harness updates them weekly and aggregates across scenarios via the `AggregatorTransport`.

Per checkpoint the harness invokes a Python Monte Carlo engine (the AI Futures takeoff simulator) bundled at bootstrap time, feeds it the current evidence state, and writes back a typed numeric `Prediction` with 50 / 80 / 95% intervals. Skill frontmatter declares which `HarnessComponent`s the worker may touch — `factors`, `evidence`, `uncertainty`, or `simulation` — so audits can attribute every revision to a component.

Aggregation: the `atc` scenario is not run by an SDK worker; it's computed deterministically by `AggregatorTransport` from the current per-scenario predictions, so the aggregate is always self-consistent with its inputs.

components.name: Question generator
components.role: Builds the (scenario × milestone) and takeoff-parameter sub-question families.

components.name: Harness bootstrap
components.role: Writes initial harness skills + question files into the VFS, idempotent on content hash.

components.name: Monte Carlo simulator
components.role: Thin Rust binding around the Python takeoff engine; runs as a subprocess each checkpoint.

components.name: ATC aggregator transport
components.role: Replaces an SDK worker for the `atc` scenario; deterministically combines sibling scenarios' current predictions.

components.name: Frozen-parameters reproducibility
components.role: Used by the eval crate's `replay::aifutures_frozen` reproducibility check.

inputs.name: Evidence state
inputs.description: Curated facts the harness has gathered, refreshed each checkpoint.

inputs.name: Frozen takeoff parameters
inputs.description: AI Futures' published parameter set, embedded in the harness skill bundle.

outputs.name: Numeric predictions
outputs.description: Per checkpoint: posterior mean year + 50/80/95% intervals.

outputs.name: Checkpoint notes
outputs.description: Narrative explaining how the prediction moved.

outputs.name: Revision records
outputs.description: Provenance: which evidence revisions affected which posterior.

outputs.name: ATC aggregate
outputs.description: Computed by `AggregatorTransport`; consistent with sibling scenarios.
